Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine(null);
$urls = ["https://example.com/good1", "https://example.com/bad", "https://example.com/good2"];
$result = Crawlberg::batchScrape($engine, $urls);
var_dump($result->completedCount);
var_dump($result->failedCount);
var_dump($result->totalCount);
```
